task_description: Implement a manual global price sync mechanism. Admin can make multiple price changes throughout the day without triggering syncs. When ready, admin clicks a 'Sync Prices to All Devices' button that writes to a Firestore signal document. All connected employee devices have a real-time listener on this document and automatically refresh their prices when it changes.
